description: Rows the default-on hydro door (woof/hydro/door.py) tries in priority order for a forecast's parent grid. A new fabric source is a row here, never a new code path. A row is used only when it covers the domain, its data licence is verified, its realization is admitted, and its own tool answers the availability probe. Coverage is a WGS84 bounding box [west, south, east, north] (west > east crosses the dateline) or "global"; the builder decides reach-level coverage. Extra rows can be appended from $WOOF_HYDRO_FABRIC_PROVIDERS.

coupled_parent_lsm.reason: Resident parent runoff and PET hooks support Noah (2), RUC (3), and Noah-MP (4): Noah-MP through its per-step RUNSRF/RUNSUB carriers (parent-noahmp-routed), Noah and RUC through their accumulated SFCRUNOFF/UDRUNOFF differenced per LSM call (parent-noah-routed, parent-ruc-routed).
